sentences.text: Through: Ms. Latika Malhot  for R-2/DDA.

Mr. Sanjay Kuma  Counsel with Mr  Mr. Sunil Kumar  Akhtar, Advocat  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VIBHU BAKHRU  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE TEJAS KARIA  ORDER % 06.03.2025 1.

The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner has drawn the attention of this court to the paragraph Nos. 7 and 8 of the affidavit filed by the DDA which sets out the status of the land in question.

Paragraph Nos. 7 and 8 of the counter-affidavit are set out below:
"7.

That as per Revenue Records available in Land Management/EastZone/DDA, the status of the following Khasra No. is as under:-
 Serial No. Khasra Total A  No. 
 
 
 
This is a digitally signed order.

sentences.text:
That the petitioner has claimed the aforesaid land of Khasra No.486 min (0-4),
487 min ()-2), 444 min (0-4) & 605 min (0-5).
Total Area i.e. 15 Biswa land of village Gharauli which is left out from the Award No.40/1978-79 dated 31.101.1979.
It is submitted that the total area of aforesaid Khasra No.'s has been utilized by the Government Agencies."

2. It is apparent from the above that certain lands which are reflected in the 5th column of the tabular statement set out in paragraph 7 of the DDA's counter-affidavit are not forming a part of the award.

The learned counsel for the petitioner is not aware whether the entire land including small portions of the land which were covered under Award No. 40/1978-79 were also covered under the notification issued under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
However, as the award in respect of the said land has not been made, prima facie, the petitioner would be entitled to retain the possession of the said land.

And, if the petitioner is deprived of the possession of the said land, he would, prima facie, be entitled to compensation for the use of the land as well as compensation for the value of the land as and when acquired.
3. The DDA's affidavit indicates that the possession of the said area is with other Government Agencies.
The learned counsel for the DDA seeks time to obtain necessary instructions as to who is in possession of the said This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 11/03/2025 at 21:54:23 land.

4. The LAC is also directed to make enquiries and to file an affidavit clearly stating as to whether the possession of the land in question [4 biswas in Khasra No. 486, 2 biswas in Khasra No. 487, 4 biswas in Khasra No. 444 and 5 biswas in Khasra No. 605] was taken over and whether compensation for the same has been tendered.
5. The respondents shall file an additional affidavit in respect of the aforesaid within a period of four weeks from date.

6. List on 03.07.2025.
VIBHU BAKHRU, J TEJAS KARIA, J MARCH 06, 2025/tr
